gate: Watch how a person carrying this code commits to a craft. They will not stop at competent. The rehearsal becomes its own kind of pleasure, the small adjustments, the same passage repeated until the hand finally knows it. This is the drive for skill, not as ambition but as appetite. Something inside wants to get good at the thing, and good is a moving target. The enthusiasm is the engine. Without it, the long hours never get spent and the mastery never arrives. The common misread is to mistake this gate for restless dabbling, for someone who leaps in too fast and abandons what they start. That can happen when the enthusiasm runs ahead of any real ground to stand on. But the gate itself is not shallow. It is the spark that, when it lands on the right material, burns long enough to make a true artist. The leap is the beginning. The repetition is what the code is for.
centre_field: The throat is the body-map's town square. Every other centre is pushing energy toward it, hoping to be turned into something the world can hear or see or use. That is what the throat does, it manifests, it takes pressure from elsewhere and makes it speech, art, action, a finished thing. Placing this gate here is the teaching. The skill is not built for private satisfaction. It is built to come out. A talent kept hidden in the throat begins to choke the person carrying it, because the throat's whole job is the bringing-forth. The misread is to treat mastery as a long inward project, perfected in solitude before any showing. That gets the anatomy backwards. The throat does not store. It releases. The enthusiasm and the practice and the depth all converge here for one purpose, to be expressed, taught, performed, shipped. Held back too long, the energy turns on itself. The voice strains. The body tires. The unspoken skill becomes a weight.
channel: Enthusiasm on its own goes shallow. The leap into a new thing, the rush of beginning, the willingness to wing it for a while, all of that lives in this code. But left alone, the spark moves to the next bright object before any real skill has time to root. This gate reaches toward the gate of depth, and the two together form the channel of talent. The reach is what saves the enthusiasm from becoming a trail of half-finished projects. The depth is patient. It holds the practitioner in the same material long after the novelty has burned off, asks the slower questions, refuses to be impressed by the surface. Joined, the enthusiasm and the depth become talent, the real article, mastered through repetition the way a musician finally owns a piece after a thousand passes. Alone, this code is a series of bright entrances with no follow-through. Paired with depth, the bright entrance becomes the start of a life's craft.
